runtimeArgs: const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const root='/Users/omotolaolasope/Documents/GitHub/halite-and-ember-foundation';const types={'.html':'text/html; charset=utf-8','.woff2':'font/woff2','.css':'text/css; charset=utf-8','.js':'text/javascript; charset=utf-8','.png':'image/png','.svg':'image/svg+xml','.txt':'text/plain; charset=utf-8'};http.createServer((req,res)=>{let rel=decodeURIComponent(req.url.split('?')[0]);if(rel.endsWith('/'))rel+='index.html';const file=p.join(root,rel);if(!file.startsWith(root)){res.writeHead(403);return res.end('Forbidden');}fs.readFile(file,(err,data)=>{if(err){return fs.readFile(p.join(root,'404.html'),(e2,body)=>{res.writeHead(404,{'content-type':'text/html; charset=utf-8'});res.end(e2?'Not found':body);});}res.writeHead(200,{'content-type':types[p.extname(file)]||'application/octet-stream'});res.end(data);});}).listen(8000,'127.0.0.1',()=>console.log('serving on http://127.0.0.1:8000'))
